title: Google Search Console HTML verification file accessible at site root (with trailing-slash resilience)

requirements.summary: Serve the Google Search Console verification HTML file as a static asset at the exact site-root path with correct body content.
acceptanceCriteria: A GET request to `https://vsapplianceshub.in/googlea74065339385fd9b.html` returns HTTP 200.
The response body contains the exact text `google-site-verification: googlea74065339385fd9b.html`.
The file is served as a static asset from the deployed frontend (not via a React route).

file_operations.description: Ensure the root-level static verification file exists and its contents match exactly `google-site-verification: googlea74065339385fd9b.html` (avoid extra markup; keep it as a plain static asset).

requirements.summary: Make the verification file accessible with a trailing slash while preserving the non-trailing-slash URL.
acceptanceCriteria: A GET request to `https://vsapplianceshub.in/googlea74065339385fd9b.html/` returns HTTP 200 (not 404).
The trailing-slash response body contains `google-site-verification: googlea74065339385fd9b.html`.
The non-trailing-slash URL `https://vsapplianceshub.in/googlea74065339385fd9b.html` continues to work as before.

file_operations.description: Add a static hosting rewrite rule to serve the same verification content for `/googlea74065339385fd9b.html/` as `/googlea74065339385fd9b.html` using a 200 (rewrite) behavior, so the trailing-slash URL returns 200 with the verification body without breaking the non-trailing-slash URL.
